surface: The Powered by bar of a key that carries the badge: Tab out of the grid to its link and Shift+Tab back.

steps.note: The page's key is a sponsored one with the badge flag (the catalog fixture), so a `Powered by Handsontable DataGrid` link shows under the grid. The page's first item is a text field, so the reader starts on the page (`start: page`). Tab from C1, the last column, leaves the grid for the link. Required: its name and role.
Shift+Tab moves back into the grid, on C1.
Tab reaches the link again: it sits in the Tab order right after the grid.
